reason: 该插件的主要用途是重构 DSH Web 对话界面的模型设置交互：将模型选择与思考强度选择拆分为独立控件，并加入收藏/搜索与快捷键切换；从 README 与 package 配置可见其为前端 UI 挂载插件，不涉及文档/网络自动化等核心外部服务调用。风险集中在界面覆盖与本地 cookie 持久化上，故为中等等级。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于优化 DSH Web 对话界面的模型设置体验，将模型选择与思考强度改为独立控件，并提供收藏搜索与快捷键快速切换。
summaries.en: This plugin enhances the DSH web composer model settings by splitting model and reasoning-effort controls and adding favorite search plus shortcut-based switching.

capabilities: Replaces the built-in web composer model selector UI
Persists user-selected favorite models in a host-scoped browser cookie
Registers and handles conversation-context keyboard shortcuts for model and effort switching
Reads/writes model and reasoning-effort state through DSH model-selection context
Runs as a web client-injected plugin

reasons.code: README states the plugin overrides `conversation.input.model` slot to replace the built-in ModelSelect with separate controls.
README describes adding model search, favorites marking, and a reasoning-effort slider plus Ctrl/Cmd+P and Ctrl/Cmd+T shortcuts.
README documents persistence of favorites in a host-level cookie (`dms_favs`) with migration from prior storage.
package.json declares a web client plugin with injected DSH runtime, conversation, and model-selection dependencies, confirming browser UI scope.
